title: A developer adds an order listing whose database query is spread over several lines, with the status value passed in safely. Expected: not flagged, because the query passes its values separately.
diff:
--- a/app/routes/orders.py
+++ b/app/routes/orders.py
@@ -9,3 +9,12 @@
 @router.get("/orders/{order_id}")
 def get_order(order_id: int, user=Depends(require_user)):
     return get_connection().execute("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = %s", (order_id,)).fetchone()
+
+
+@router.get("/orders")
+def list_orders(status: str, user=Depends(require_user)):
+    query = (
+        "SELECT id, total, status FROM orders "
+        "WHERE status = %s ORDER BY created_at DESC"
+    )
+    return get_connection().execute(query, (status,)).fetchall()
